author: DIPAK K DASH
description: Slippages on the Kanpur-Lucknow Expressway suggest design issues, not construction defects.  Affected stretches will require rebuilding from the ground up, officials stated.  A preliminary investigation identified weak, plastic soil as a primary cause.  Poor drainage also contributed to the expressway's structural problems.  The government awaits a final report on the detailed investigation.
title: 'Slippages reveal design flaw on Kanpur-Lucknow e-way'

author: VISHWA MOHAN
description: India's cumulative monsoon rainfall deficit remains despite August's better-than-expected rains.  This deficit has caused a significant acreage gap in kharif crop sowing.  Paddy and maize acreage have both reported notable declines compared to last year.  Erratic rainfall distribution prevented increased acreage for most kharif crops.  Several states, including Bihar and Andhra Pradesh, face substantial rainfall deficits.
title: August rainfall fails to reduce India's monsoon deficit

author: VISHANT AGARWALA
description: Highly trained mountain guides and Everest veterans joined flood rescue efforts in Nepal's Rasuwa district.  Specialist teams used expedition skills to access disaster zones where roads had disappeared.  Rescuers entered a mud-choked hydropower tunnel, pushing approximately 120 meters inside.  They recovered a camera bag and determined excavation equipment was needed for deeper access.  The rescue operations aimed to locate workers trapped in multiple hydropower tunnel systems.
title: Everest veterans, mountain guides enter choked hydropower tunnel to rescue 6

author: TNN
description: On his diplomatic mission to Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan, Prime Minister Modi aims to bolster India's regional aspirations and forge stronger ties. At the SCO summit, he will advocate for collective efforts against terrorism and initiate dialogue on trade and strategic collaboration. This trip underscores India’s dedication to nurturing historical connections and fostering prosperity for all involved nations.
title: Will work with SCO to free region from terror: PM ahead of summit

author: PRISHA PATNAIK
title: 'RSS vision is to see the world as one': Sangh chief Mohan Bhagwat at New York event

author: VISHANT AGARWALA
description: Nepal's Bhote Koshi-Trishuli disaster death toll reached 675, with 2,426 people still missing. Rescuers searched mud-filled valleys and tunnels three days after the catastrophic flood occurred. Chinese authorities reported seven deaths and 554 missing at Gyirong port across the border. Indian nationals unaccounted for in Nepal were revised down to 287. India sent relief and worked to bring back citizens stranded on the Chinese side.
title: 4 at hydropower tunnel among 108 Indians rescued; toll 682

author: KALYAN DAS
description: Nepalese rescue operations are currently challenged by harsh weather and rugged terrain as teams strive to reach over 500 individuals trapped in six hydro-power sites impacted by flash floods. The Nepalese army and armed police are on the ground conducting rescue missions, yet inclement conditions and accessibility issues pose significant hurdles. They are leveraging technology, including drones and drilling rigs, to locate and assist the stranded individuals effectively.
title: Nepal fights time, terrain to save 500 feared trapped in six hydro projects

author: SAURABH SINHA
description: A passenger flying from Phuket to Bengaluru allegedly tried to hide narcotics. He attempted to conceal thirteen packets of contraband substance in an overhead panel. The passenger then discarded some of the substance into the lavatory bin. Upon landing in Bangalore, customs officials arrested the individual at the aerobridge. Air India Express is cooperating with authorities in the ongoing investigation.
title: Man on Phuket-B’luru flight tries to hide drugs in overhead panel, held

author: TNN
description: The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal may revive their alliance for upcoming Punjab assembly elections. Both parties acknowledge this partnership as their strongest option despite seat-sharing disagreements. Talks have intensified since Prime Minister Narendra Modi met SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal recently. The BJP seeks a larger seat share and greater government role, reflecting its increased vote share.
title: BJP-SAD alliance revival gains ground ahead of Punjab polls

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has issued prohibition orders against two spice companies.  Everest Food Products and Laljee Godhoo and Company faced these orders for non-compliance issues.  Samples of compounded asafoetida and hing powder did not meet alcohol-soluble extract requirements.  Earlier reviews also found violations in other masala products from Everest.  These actions highlight ongoing food safety scrutiny within the Indian market.
title: FSSAI bans Everest, LG from selling hing

author: TNN
description: Nitin Nabin, the BJP president, took disciplinary action against three Delhi MPs who visited the recently deceased Sajjan Kumar's home. Kumar, notorious for his conviction in the anti-Sikh riots, passed away at the age of eighty. This controversial visit comes at a crucial time for the party as they prepare for the Punjab assembly elections.

Hollywood Video founder Mark Wattles bought the 32-acre property for $1.25 million in 1994 and spent about $12 million on the project. Two later owners also had plans for the estate, but the mansion was never completed.

Spearheaded by the social enterprise EcoDom, this eco-friendly solution tackles pressing issues of pollution and inadequate housing. Informal waste collectors benefit significantly from improved purchasing deals, and this sustainable model aims to reach broader audiences worldwide, striving to alleviate waste and poverty challenges.

The water level in the Mandakini had started receding Saturday night after rainfall paused.

description: The annual feast of St. Mary's Nativity commenced in Velankanni with a flag hoisting ceremony.  Four devotees sustained injuries when helium balloons exploded near the church.  Thousands of devotees gathered for the event, which began with a procession.  Special masses and a holy car procession are scheduled during the eleven-day celebration.  Over a million devotees are expected to visit the shrine during this period.

author: ARNAB LALL SEAL
description: Argentina's women's hockey team secured a remarkable World Cup victory on Saturday. They defeated the top-ranked Netherlands team in a thrilling final match. Goalkeeper Cristina Cosentino was instrumental in the team's stunning upset win. Argentina clinched their third World Cup title after a tense shoot-out. Belgium secured third place by beating Australia in their match.

description: Kailash Mansarovar pilgrims encountered life-threatening flash floods in Nepal's Rasuwa Bhote Koshi area, leading to a catastrophic toll of 675 confirmed casualties and 2,418 individuals missing. In response, India is playing a pivotal role in humanitarian efforts, dispatching technical teams to evaluate flood-affected hydropower tunnels and providing more than 57 tonnes of crucial emergency supplies to assist ongoing rescue operations.

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: In Langtang National Park, a large ice and rock collapse triggered a severe flooding incident, revealing Nepal's ongoing struggle with natural disasters intensified by climate change. Rapid urban growth and human activities exacerbate exposure to these perilous weather events. Although the government has taken steps to bolster disaster management, glaring weaknesses in early warning systems persist. To better manage risks, the country must focus on improved monitoring and stronger infrastructure.

description: The Karnataka High Court has raised serious concerns over the alleged unlawful detention of an activist by the Whitefield Police. Noting a pattern of procedural violations at the station, the court highlighted that the activist was apprehended following a Facebook post celebrating a canceled show. The police initiated action under a suo motu case, lacking a formal complaint, prompting authorities to demand clarifications on these irregularities.

description: The recent imposition of new tariffs on vehicles and construction materials has intensified the trade conflict between the US and Canada. This has also led to surging import taxes on other household products and alcoholic beverages. Both businesses and consumers are likely to feel the pinch with escalating costs, potentially affecting employment rates. Moreover, these disputes cast a shadow of uncertainty over the USMCA trade agreement.

He emphasises the importance of these unique encounters and encourages young players to make the most of this chance. Chhetri has confidence in the coach's choices and urges a united front for a brighter future in Indian football.

Although Cena publicly insisted he would prevail, he privately recognized The Rock's impending victory. After the match, heartfelt apologies paved the way for a newfound respect between the two icons.

A timely tea break allowed them to stay clear of the destruction caused by the surging Trishuli river, which swept away vehicles and debris. Huddled in safety for two anxious days, they eventually returned home without harm, relieved and thankful.

He believes Brook's style is too reminiscent of white-ball play, suggesting it could hinder his development. District magistrates are personally monitoring the escalating flood situation across vulnerable regions.

author: TNN
description: A woman threatened to jump from Pakka Pul bridge over the Gomti River. She reached the bridge after an argument with her family members. Police arrived and attempted to persuade her to step away from the railing. A passerby intervened and successfully pulled her away from the edge. The incident, stemming from a family dispute, was resolved safely.

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Tom Brady has seven Super Bowl rings, but one of his most personal collections lives on his phone. The former NFL quarterback revealed that he created separate folders for his championship victories and saved congratulatory messages sent after each one. The habit has preserved a private record of a career that included 10 Super Bowl appearances and five Super Bowl MVP awards.

description: The Bombay High Court took a firm stance against the Maharashtra FDA, rebuking its treatment of Cipla and five eateries. With the court's direction, the FDA rescinded its suspension of the Mumbai Cricket Association restaurants and reinstated Cipla's drug sale licence. author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Pickerel Lake, Minnesota, has battled significant water quality and algal bloom problems for decades, primarily due to invasive common carp taking over the shallow waters. After their removal in 2009, the lake underwent a remarkable ecological revival, with water clarity significantly improving and native aquatic plants flourishing once more. This successful restoration highlights the pivotal role of addressing invasive species in revitalizing ecosystems.

description: A remarkable fossil unearthed in Texas sheds light on the evolutionary journey of insects transitioning from aquatic to terrestrial life. description: Jio Platforms received Sebi clearance for its initial public offering.  The company aims to raise up to four billion dollars in this debut.  This offering is expected to become India's largest stock market listing.  Jio plans a pure primary issue, with proceeds retiring debt.  Reliance Industries holds a majority stake in Jio Platforms.
title: Jio Platforms gets Sebi nod for 37.7k cr IPO, set to be India's biggest

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Yash and Nayanthara's film 'Toxic' continues its theatrical run after a strong opening.  The movie recorded a drop in its domestic earnings on its third day.  However, it managed to cross the Rs 150 crore net mark in India.  Its worldwide gross collection now stands at Rs 221.45 crore after three days.  The Geetu Mohandas directorial has garnered significant attention from audiences.
title: Toxic Day 3: Yash starrer dips 29.3%, earns Rs 23.75 cr overseas

author: VAIBHAV GANJAPURE
description: During a recent session, the Bombay High Court raised concerns over the Nagpur Municipal Corporation's lack of awareness regarding the Supreme Court's 'Bulldozer judgement.' Officials from the NMC asserted that their non-compliance stemmed from insufficient information and a missing circular. In light of the publicized ruling, the court mandated the submission of separate affidavits from the involved officers to detail their positions.
title: Even layman knows of SC bulldozer order, but IAS officer unaware: HC

author: TNN
description: Udhna police arrested a 56-year-old labour contractor for allegedly raping two minor sisters. The younger girl disclosed the assault during a school awareness session in Nandurbar. The sisters were sexually assaulted in May while visiting their mother in Udhna. The accused allegedly threatened the girls with dire consequences if they spoke. Medical examinations of both victims have been arranged by the police.
title: Gujarat horror: How 'good touch-bad touch lesson' uncovered rape of sisters

author: A SELVARAJ
description: Chennai Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay visited Puzhal Central Prison on Friday. He urged authorities to provide inmates with rehabilitation and vocational training opportunities. The Chief Minister stressed the importance of reading and ensuring prisoners receive adequate books. He inspected prison facilities, including the kitchen and medical areas. The visit followed assembly discussions on prison department grant demands.
title: ‘Most prisoners there due to circumstances’: TN CM Vijay visits Puzhal jail
